table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale'   else item.name end,
			packingdesc=max(item.packingdesc),
			reprintdate=getdate(),
			users.username,  
			accounts.name, 
			customeraddress1=(select address1 from customer where customer.custcode=max(saleledger.custcode)),
			customeraddress2=(select address2 from customer where customer.custcode=max(saleledger.custcode)),
			customeralias=(select aliasname from accounts where accounts.acccode=max(saleledger.custcode)),
			headerno =max(saleledger.headerno),
			posted=max(saleledger.posted),
			balance=isnull(max(balance),0),
			amt=isnull(saleledger.amt,0) + isnull(saleledger.cashcharged,0) + ISNULL((select isnull(sum(amount),0) from cashierwindow where cashierwindow.saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode), 0),
			itemdescription=max(rtrim(ltrim(saledetail.saleitemdescription))),
			dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         dbo.saleledger.date,
         dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
         dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
         dbo.saleledger.remarks,
   		dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
         dbo.saledetail.icode,   
         dbo.saledetail.gcode,
		 printbalance=max(saleledger.printbalance),
         salecatcode=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
		Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),     
         looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
		bonusqty=sum(saledetail.bonusqty),
		/*itemtotalqty=(select sum(looseqty) from saledetail SD where SD.saleinvcode= max(saledetail.saleinvcode) and SD.icode=saledetail.icode),*/
		itemtotalqty=sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
		packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
		packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	 	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
		batch=saledetail.batch,
	 	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
         salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
         discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc), 
		customername='                                  '  ,
         itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
		unitsalestax  = max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
		gstperc       = max(saledetail.gstperc),
		invgstperc    = max(saleledger.invgstperc1),
		reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
		serverdate=getdate()

    FROM dbo.saleledger,   
         dbo.saledetail,  
         item, 
			customer, 
			accounts,
			users 

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
         
			( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
			( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
			( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
			( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
			( saledetail.icode = item.icode )  

GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
			saleledger.date, 
			/*saleledger.headerno,*/
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.discperc, 
			saleledger.flatdisc, 
			saleledger.misccharges, 
			saleledger.salestax, 
			saleledger.remarks,
			saleledger.custrefno,
			saleledger.amt, 
			saleledger.cashcharged,
			saledetail.icode,
			saledetail.batch,
			saledetail.rowgroup, 
			saledetail.gcode, 
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable, 
			accounts.name,
			dbo.users.username
ORDER BY 
			MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_sumitemleveltaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) ,2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: Sum ( (  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice - looseqty * itemflatdisc )  *  saledetail_discperc  * .01  )

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: sum((  looseqty *  saledetail_saleprice - looseqty * itemflatdisc )  *  ( 1 -  (   saledetail_discperc  * .01 )  ) +round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round(looseqty * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01),2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: compute_6
objects.visible:
1	if( getrow()=rowcount() AND salecatcode <> 3 AND printbalance='Y' AND 
( (posted='N' AND f_StringPreferences('CustBalanceOnPrintOut')='Y') OR

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  saleledger_flatdisc  +  saleledger_misccharges  + saleledger_salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - saleledger_discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  saleledger_flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)
